Hi Logan / Vanessa,

Thanks again — Acme Finance is ready to move forward with the annual committed prepay for 2027. Before we sign, a couple of operational questions so we can close our internal PO and treasury workflows:

- Can Redwood perform a monthly automated withdrawal (sweep) from our prepay balance rather than issuing separate invoices each month? If so, can you confirm typical sweep dates (1st or 15th) and whether partial mid-month draws are supported?
- We operate both in the US and EU. For our EU entity (VAT GB999999999), do you issue VAT invoices or do we need to handle reverse-charge? Please highlight what billing entity you need on the invoice to avoid VAT mismatches.
- Please confirm the formats you need for: PO, remittance instructions, GL code, and contact for wiring/tracker.

I've attached our draft PO for the committed prepay to this message (RINF_Acme_Annual_Commitment_PO_20261014.pdf).

Looking to get this closed in the next two weeks — appreciate a quick playbook so our procurement and treasury teams can align.

Thanks,

Laura — thanks, and great to hear Acme is ready. Quick summary of options and what we need from your side to operationalize the committed prepay: 

1) Sweep cadence options (we can do any of the below):
   - Monthly fixed sweep (recommended): draw on the 1st of month against the prepay pool; amount equals forecasted monthly consumption or a fixed tranche.
   - Bi-monthly / semi-monthly: 1st and 15th for tighter cashflow alignment.
   - Event-driven micro-withdrawals: small pulls on invoice generation (adds overhead, higher ops coordination).

2) VAT / tax routing: Redwood can issue VAT-bearing invoices when billing an EU-registered entity. We need the exact legal entity name and VAT number to put on the invoice. If you prefer reverse-charge, provide the EU entity details and we'll mark the invoice accordingly — this requires your VAT # and the appropriate billing address.

3) What we need from Acme to proceed:
   - Signed PO (we received your draft — thanks).
   - Remittance instructions / bank details (for ACH/wire) and preferred sweep day.
   - GL code(s) to include on the invoice line items (optional but helpful).

4) Operational handoffs: I’m looping Vivek (billing) and Monica (payments ops) to finalize the withdrawal schedule and to prepare the invoice templates and VAT wording. We'll populate the attached withdrawal_schedule_v1.xlsx (I’ll send version with sample amounts after Vivek confirms).

Next steps from our side:
- Vivek will propose a withdrawal cadence and sample amounts.
- We’ll prepare a billing schedule and a DocuSign for the PO if you want electronic signature.

If that all sounds right, can you confirm preferred sweep cadence and whether you want Redwood to bill the US parent or the EU operating entity for VAT purposes?

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Laura / team — looping in billing ops. Thanks for confirming EU billing entity and the monthly 1st sweep. A few operational clarifications and what we'll deliver: 

1) VAT handling: since you're asking to be billed at the EU entity, Redwood will issue VAT-bearing invoices to Acme Analytics EU Ltd using the VAT number you provided. Our invoice will show the VAT line and your VAT #. If you later prefer reverse-charge, we'll need a signed confirmation from your tax team and we will update the invoice wording.

2) Withdrawal mechanics: we will convert the annual prepay into a monthly draw schedule (12 tranches) and perform an automated ACH/wire pull on the 1st of each month. 
   - Each draw will post as a credit application against the prepay balance; a monthly invoice reflecting consumed tokens and the credited tranche will be created for audit.
   - We can include a custom reference field that contains your GL code (5402) on each invoice line and in the remittance description — please confirm exact GL string you want prefixed (e.g., "5402-ML" or just "5402").

3) Required items from Acme to start:
   - Signed PO (received) — thanks.
   - Final remittance instructions (bank ACH/wire and remit email).
   - Preferred sweep bank details for pull: ACH or wire (we need the routing/IBAN and name on account).

4) Deliverables from Redwood (by 2026-10-18):
   - Populated withdrawal_schedule_v1.xlsx with sample tranche amounts and sweep dates (attached).
   - Draft VAT invoice template for your tax review.
   - DocuSign link for the PO if you want to e-sign (we can do standard or account-level SOW).

Attachment: withdrawal_schedule_v1.xlsx (current sheet contains sample split — please review and tell us if you want different tranche sizes or a front-loaded schedule).

We will not perform any draws until we have your remittance details and final confirmation of the GL mapping. Once we have that, we can schedule the first sweep for 2026-11-01.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
